bands.label: Green
bands.disposition: No measurable burden. Walk the corridor.

bands.label: White
bands.disposition: Trace exposure only. The ledger notes it without alarm.

bands.label: Yellow
bands.disposition: Minor accumulation. Duty continues; the dial is watched.

bands.label: Amber
bands.disposition: The ledger shows a number worth watching.

bands.label: Orange
bands.disposition: Moderate exposure. Restricted duty begins here; heavy work is reassigned.

bands.label: Rose
bands.disposition: Significant accumulation. Light duty only. The register is marked in ink, not pencil.

bands.label: Red
bands.disposition: Named on the sick list. Care is a choice, not a cure.

bands.label: Crimson
bands.disposition: Severe exposure. Sick-room priority. The nurse is notified before the registrar.

bands.label: Violet
bands.disposition: Critical accumulation. Comfort care is the first option on the ledger.

bands.label: Black
bands.disposition: The band the registrar will not soften. Still on the roster.

bands.label: Indigo
bands.disposition: Terminal exposure. Palliative only. The clockmaker does not correct the reading.

bands.label: Void
bands.disposition: Lethal accumulation. The registrar stops reading aloud. The column is filled in silence.

plans.label: Morphine tray
plans.note: Mercy with a schedule. The tray is refilled on the same day every week.

plans.label: Comfort rounds
plans.note: Someone sits the night. The sick room has a chair for it now.

plans.label: Nothing
plans.note: A refusal is a choice the ledger records as silence.

plans.label: Chelation therapy
plans.note: A chemical course that binds heavy isotopes and moves them out. Expensive, limited, and worth counting.

plans.label: Iodine prophylaxis
plans.note: Thyroid saturation before the dose climbs further. The window is narrow; timing is the skill.

plans.label: Isolation
plans.note: The patient is removed from shared air and touch. Secondary exposure stops here.

plans.label: Supervised rest
plans.note: Bed rest with hourly observation. Nothing curative; everything supportive.

plans.label: Transfer
plans.note: If a better facility exists and fuel permits, the patient goes. The ledger follows.

guesses.label: Low
guesses.note: A kinder story, written in pencil.

guesses.label: Honest
guesses.note: The truer number as it stands, subject to correction.

guesses.label: Refused
guesses.note: No guess at all. The board stays blank until the dial speaks.

calibration.drift_note: Every figure has a drift. The drift is normal. Piet will not lie about it to make a reading land softer.

npcs.name: Dr. Irina Vel
npcs.disposition: Radiation Registrar. Holds a red pencil and will not read a number up to make it easier. Every refused booking is a silent tally she remembers.

npcs.name: Wyn Omah
npcs.disposition: Sick-room Nurse. Presents the bed order and waits. She never shuffles the order so one person's comfort costs another's care.

npcs.name: Piet Abar
npcs.disposition: The Clockmaker. The only honest voice about error: every figure has a drift, the drift is normal, and he will not pretend otherwise.

npcs.name: Saria Voss
npcs.disposition: The Midwife. Keeps the children's board in chalk so it can be erased. She will not book a guess as a truth.
